categories.title: Agent experience
categories.what: How sessions and subagents work in the repo: memory, session start, skills, shipping and merging.

rows: Root AGENTS.md 64 lines, 916 words; five folder AGENTS.md add 585 words; no CLAUDE.md.
11 skills, 201 to 1,214 words, none over 1,500; handoff and coordinate pass 1,500 with their reference file.
38 files and 10,857 words (49 files on 27 Nov); remote runs, timing and coordinator files repeat AGENTS.md and skills.
The start hook prints nothing in 0.07 s; make orient is about 40 lines, 25 of them overlap.
make ready and make land with tests; #1377 adds a GitHub gate for drafts and a merge lock.
43 worktrees (29 agent-a*); 39 progress files, 16 older than a day; nothing prunes agent worktrees.

notes: The 27 Nov costs: memory 49 to 38 files (overlap remains); session start one line per worktree to none (fixed); two skills over 2,000 words to none over 1,500 (fixed); 37 stale progress files to 39 live ones (not fixed).
The 28 Nov rescore scored six areas, two of them (housekeeping, memory overlap) wider than the 27 Nov review looked, so part of the drop is the wider look rather than a regression.
